description: 2 to 4 companies side by side, aligned on calendar quarters as Annalist Compare places their fiscal periods, so that companies whose fiscal years end in different months stand in the same quarter. Measures are ratio ids (corp.operating_margin, corp.roic, corp.revenue_growth, bank.roe; short names such as roic work) or statement items (revenue, net_income, total_assets, cfo). Ratios use the last 4 quarters where the ratio has them, else the quarter; a company that reports fiscal years only gives fiscal years. Each value gives the company's fiscal period, and each statement value its source document ids. Amounts stay in the currency of each company.

frequency.description: the form of every ratio, in place of the last 4 quarters where a ratio has them; annual compares fiscal years

from.description: first calendar quarter: CY2025 Q1, a year (2025) or an ISO date

measures.description: 1 to 6 ratio ids or statement item keys, for example ["corp.operating_margin", "revenue"]

to.description: last calendar quarter, in the same forms

name: compare_companies
title: Compare companies on calendar quarters
